_comment: Presets for the studio. Edit freely: add an entry, reload the page, it appears.
sing  -> model 'yue2' uses style + lyrics (sections in [Verse] [Chorus] [Bridge] tags);
model 'stable-audio' uses prompt + duration (max 120 s, instrumental only).
speak -> model 'kokoro' uses voice; 'qwen3' uses speaker + instruct; 'voxcpm2' can clone.
Style words about PRODUCTION ('polished demo mix', 'close mic') move the result as much

sing.name: Indie pop

sing.lyrics:

speak.name: Podcast intro
speak.text: Welcome back to the show. Today we're talking about three second-hand graphics cards that learned to sing. Grab a coffee — this one is a good one.

speak.name: News read
speak.text: Good evening. Engineers working on a home server have confirmed that the machine can now generate complete songs faster than real time, using a single graphics card.

speak.name: Audiobook narration
speak.text: The tower stood under the desk for two years, humming quietly to itself. Nobody expected it to speak. And nobody, least of all the tower, expected it to sing.

speak.name: Friendly assistant
speak.text: Hi! Your song is ready. I made three versions — have a listen and pick the one you like best.

speak.name: Excited advert
speak.speaker: Ryan
speak.instruct: Very excited and energetic, like a radio advert.
speak.text: Introducing the studio that lives under your desk! Songs, voices, and transcripts — all on your own machine. No subscription. No waiting. Just press generate!

speak.name: Calm meditation
speak.speaker: Serena
speak.instruct: Slow, calm, soothing, soft and gentle.
speak.text: Breathe in slowly. Hold it for a moment. And let it go. Let your shoulders drop, and notice the quiet around you.

speak.name: Documentary
speak.speaker: Eric
speak.instruct: Serious, measured and authoritative, like a nature documentary narrator.
speak.text: Deep inside the machine, three processors work in silence. Each one alone. Each one, for the first time, making a sound.

speak.name: Bahasa Indonesia
speak.text: Selamat datang di studio. Mesin ini sekarang bisa berbicara, mendengar, dan bernyanyi. Silakan pilih template dan tekan tombol buat.

speak.name: Studio narration 48 kHz
speak.text: This voice is rendered at forty-eight thousand samples a second — twice the detail of the other voices in this studio.

speak.name: Clone a voice
speak.text: This is a cloned voice, made from a short recording. Only clone a voice you have permission to use.
